gate_A.rule: flag if AUC upper 95% bound is below 0.55 or predicted SD below .025; flag lack of Brier improvement if no benchmark passes

transfer_material_failure.rule: flag ECE or gap over threshold; flag slope only if 95% interval entirely outside interval; test against cohort-constant Brier diagnostically

gate_B.rule: review if keeper-value Spearman below .5 in two cohorts with at least 10 keepers, or substantively opposite replicated headline conclusions

primary_label_definition: own control or explicitly awarded restart at immediate resolution
